soldiers.soldier: Cleavers by the keep. Full damage to spiders, wargs and gnolls, a third to anything else.
Pikemen by the keep, ignoring armour: full damage to orcs, ogres and trolls.
Slingers by the keep; the only soldiers who reach flyers. Full damage to wyverns.
Rolls a boulder up the path: hits every ground creature it touches, and wears down as it goes.
